data_interpretation: Hessenkasse assumed over EUR 4.9bn from 179 municipalities; municipal Kassenkredite reduction in 2018 cannot be treated as self-financed repayment. EUR 4.9bn is a lower-bound rounded value.
Dec 2024 transfer approximately EUR 2.97bn; approx EUR 29m remaining from approved 3bn volume. 2024 municipal debt decline structurally affected by intergovernmental transfer.
Authorization ceiling not proof EUR 1bn already taken over; transferred through 2023 EUR 668.59m as separately documented by state audit authority.
Law entered into force 18 July 2025; applications ran to 30 Nov 2025. Do not presume transfer amounts or effective reduction at year-end 2025 without supporting statistics.
